text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Mejiro! It's Mejiro, it's Mejiro, 
it's Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The sparkle of that late-race burst was 
truly a flash of lightning! Transforming 
into a single beam of light, she blazed 
right through the pack of Umamusume--!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*... Whoa... Even after all 
that disruption, you didn't hesitate for a 
second~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“What a truly magnificent run... Just how 
much belief does she have in herself?”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pride in one's family traditions... Can 
that alone truly inspire such deep 
resolve...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You did it, Bright-san! Merry Christmas☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Incredible... You're amazing... Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is right, everyone. This is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This is the radiance of a reborn Mejiro!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright!! She has conquered the 
Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The pride of a prestigious family, 
immortal gloryâ the Mejiro era continues 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Grand Prix victory by the heir of a 
prestigious family. The drama behind it 
isâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It shook Nakayama to its core. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Grandmother...! Bright is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes—being a Mejiro. Loving the Mejiro name 
and taking pride in it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
As long as those who hold those feelings 
continue to run— the Mejiro family will 
never fade.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I feel as though... Bright has 
just paved a brand-new path for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer~. I won, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I, who was once a burden... have become 
the hope of the Mejiro family, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I always believed this day would come... 
Though it took quite a long time to get 
here...
choice_data_list:
Because even so, you always "come through" 
for me.

Even so, because I know you will always 
"come through" for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. So that many people will finally 
come to believe so~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was so slow and carefree, 
and nobody believed in me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far behind she fell, Mejiro 
Bright always kept her eyes fixed on the 
summit from the very back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And I wasn't the only one... who realized 
that.
choice_data_list:
I always believed in you. Both Grandmother 
and I did.

I always believed in you. Both Grandmother 
and I did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... Trainer-sama...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning a smile through tears... a 
finger gently pointed toward the Winner's 
Circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The victor must lead. Becoming the light 
for all.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all, dear fans~ I am 
Bright of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today was a truly wonderful day. To have 
so many people gather together and compete 
in radiance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There is just one thing I would like to 
share with all of you. And that is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is about why I was able to stand in 
this circle of glory today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is because... I have been able to 
walk an aspirational path unique to the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of the Mejiro family have 
left behind many tales. Not as mere 
biographies of great figures, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is such a wonderful, freeing story. For 
each and every one of you possesses your 
own unique charm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"There was glory. There was heartbreak. 
Even so, the Mejiro horse girls never 
stopped, moving forward with the winds of 
the era at their backs..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Changing while protecting what is 
precious, that is how we've carried on to 
this day."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro has endured because we have always 
moved in the right direction as Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"And what continues from here is because I 
was able to show you our true form today, 
even as it continues to change."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I have demonstrated that 
through victory."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...It is just as you say. Preserving the 
old charm, while constantly innovating...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Long before we were ever born, 
the Mejiro family existed. Its history is 
extraordinarily long...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A house where admiration begets 
admiration. Its brilliance is surely not 
something so shallow that it could be 
swallowed up by the tides of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Respect and admiration naturally appear in 
the eyes of the Umamusume. The noble 
family continues to shine with unshakable 
power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have always been watching all the 
umamusume so very closely from the very 
back, you know? And so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I know very well just how wonderful each 
and every one of you is. Even now, as I 
stand at the head of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, shall we begin~? Mejiro 
Umamusume and non-Mejiro alike, let us all 
together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Beyond—that which I admired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the Mejiro family, once feared to 
be swept away by the sands of time, was 
revived by the brilliant light of Mejiro 
Bright."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet this is no miracle. Because—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For at the foot of Mount Yotei, countless 
stories that nurture new aspirations are 
always sparkling brightly.
